summary.text: Kristin Davis is the Democratic candidate for Maine House of Representatives District 145 in the November 3, 2026 general election, facing Republican Caleb Chase.
In a Ballotpedia survey, she said she has lived in Wells since 2017 and worked more than 15 years in maternal and infant health.

paragraphs.text: Davis graduated from Gray New Gloucester High School, earned a bachelor's degree from the University of Southern Maine and a graduate degree from American University, according to Ballotpedia, which lists her profession as director.
In a Ballotpedia survey, she said she grew up in a working Maine family and that her career in maternal and infant health gave her a background in business and finance.
Davis advanced from the Democratic primary on June 9, 2026.
In the survey, she listed her key messages as making Wells affordable, protecting seniors and investing in the next generation, and named healthcare, education and housing as her policy interests.
